name: generic_2layer
description: Generic 1.6 mm 2-layer FR-4 (0.035 mm copper, 1.51 mm core Er 4.5). No controlled-impedance dielectric menu — a 50R microstrip needs a ~2.9 mm trace here, which is the honest physics of a 1.5 mm dielectric; use a 4/6-layer profile for practical controlled impedance.
sources: Typical 2-layer FR-4 rigid build (1.6 mm nominal, 1 oz copper)
